'''Koral-tae''' was an [[Aquala/Legends|Aquala]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and retired member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Koral-tae came out of retirement to assist an Alliance team [[Mission to Ando|investigating]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ando Project|operation]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Ando/Legends|Ando]].<ref name="Ando" />
